0.name: MOVE_NONE

1.name: MOVE_POUND
description:
The foe is physically
pounded with a long
tail or a foreleg,
etc.

2.name: MOVE_KARATE_CHOP
description:
The foe is attacked
with a sharp chop.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

3.name: MOVE_DOUBLE_SLAP
description:
The foe is slapped
repeatedly, back
and forth, two to
five times in a row.

4.name: MOVE_COMET_PUNCH
description:
The foe is hit with
a flurry of punches
that strike two to
five times in a row.

5.name: MOVE_MEGA_PUNCH
description:
The foe is slugged
by a punch thrown
with muscle-packed
power.

6.name: MOVE_PAY_DAY
description:
Numerous coins are
hurled at the foe to
inflict damage.
Money is earned
after battle.

7.name: MOVE_FIRE_PUNCH
description:
The foe is punched
with a fiery fist.
It may leave the
target with a burn.

8.name: MOVE_ICE_PUNCH
description:
The foe is punched
with an icy fist.
It may leave the
target frozen.

9.name: MOVE_THUNDER_PUNCH
description:
The foe is punched
with an electrified
fist. It may leave
the target with
paralysis.

10.name: MOVE_SCRATCH
description:
Hard, pointed, and
sharp claws rake the
foe to inflict damage.

11.name: MOVE_VICE_GRIP
description:
Huge, impressive
pincers grip and
squeeze the foe.

12.name: MOVE_GUILLOTINE
description:
A vicious, tearing
attack with pincers.
The foe will faint
instantly if this
attack hits.

13.name: MOVE_RAZOR_WIND
description:
A two-turn attack.
Blades of wind hit the
foe on the second
turn. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

14.name: MOVE_SWORDS_DANCE
description:
A frenetic dance to
uplift the fighting
spirit. It sharply
raises the user’s
Attack stat.

15.name: MOVE_CUT
description:
The foe is cut with a
scythe or a claw.
It can also be used
to cut down thin
trees.

16.name: MOVE_GUST
description:
A gust of wind is
whipped up by wings
and launched at the
foe to inflict damage.

17.name: MOVE_WING_ATTACK
description:
The foe is struck
with large, imposing
wings spread wide
to inflict damage.

18.name: MOVE_WHIRLWIND
description:
The foe is blown away,
to be replaced by
another Pokémon
in its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

19.name: MOVE_FLY
description:
The user soars, then
strikes on the second
turn. It can also be
used for flying to
any familiar town.

20.name: MOVE_BIND
description:
A long body or
tentacles are used
to bind and squeeze
the foe for two to
five turns.

21.name: MOVE_SLAM
description:
The foe is slammed
with a long tail,
vines, etc., to inflict
damage.

22.name: MOVE_VINE_WHIP
description:
The foe is struck
with slender, whiplike
vines to inflict
damage.

23.name: MOVE_STOMP
description:
The foe is stomped
with a big foot.
It may also make the
target flinch.

24.name: MOVE_DOUBLE_KICK
description:
The foe is quickly
kicked twice in
succession using both
feet.

25.name: MOVE_MEGA_KICK
description:
The foe is attacked
by a kick launched
with muscle-packed
power.

26.name: MOVE_JUMP_KICK
description:
The user jumps up
high, then strikes
with a kick. If the
kick misses, the
user hurts itself.

27.name: MOVE_ROLLING_KICK
description:
The user cuts a
quick spin and lashes
out with a sharp
kick.

28.name: MOVE_SAND_ATTACK
description:
Sand is hurled in the
foe’s face, reducing
its accuracy.

29.name: MOVE_HEADBUTT
description:
The user sticks its
head out and rams
straight forward.
It may make the
foe flinch.

30.name: MOVE_HORN_ATTACK
description:
The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed horn to
inflict damage.

31.name: MOVE_FURY_ATTACK
description:
The foe is jabbed
repeatedly with a
horn or beak two to
five times in a row.

32.name: MOVE_HORN_DRILL
description:
The foe is stabbed
with a horn rotating
like a drill.
The foe instantly
faints if it hits.

33.name: MOVE_TACKLE
description:
A physical attack
in which the user
charges and slams
into the foe with
its whole body.

34.name: MOVE_BODY_SLAM
description:
The user drops onto
the foe with its full
body weight.
It may leave the foe
paralyzed.

35.name: MOVE_WRAP
description:
A long body or vines
are used to wrap and
squeeze the foe for
two to five turns.

36.name: MOVE_TAKE_DOWN
description:
A reckless, full-body
charge attack for
slamming into the foe.
It also damages the
user a little.

37.name: MOVE_THRASH
description:
The user rampages
and attacks for two
to three turns.
It then becomes
confused, however.

38.name: MOVE_DOUBLE_EDGE
description:
A reckless, life-
risking tackle.
It also damages the
user by a fairly large
amount, however.

39.name: MOVE_TAIL_WHIP
description:
The user wags its tail
cutely, making the
foe less wary.
The target’s Defense
stat is lowered.

40.name: MOVE_POISON_STING
description:
The foe is stabbed
with a poisonous
barb of some sort.
It may also poison
the target.

41.name: MOVE_TWINEEDLE
description:
The foe is stabbed
twice by a pair of
stingers.
It may also poison
the target.

42.name: MOVE_PIN_MISSILE
description:
Sharp pins are shot
at the foe in rapid
succession.
They hit two to five
times in a row.

43.name: MOVE_LEER
description:
The foe is given an
intimidating leer with
sharp eyes.
The target’s Defense
stat is reduced.

44.name: MOVE_BITE
description:
The foe is bitten with
viciously sharp fangs.
It may make the
target flinch.

45.name: MOVE_GROWL
description:
The user growls in an
endearing way, making
the foe less wary.
The target’s Attack
stat is lowered.

46.name: MOVE_ROAR
description:
The foe is scared off,
to be replaced by
another Pokémon in
its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

47.name: MOVE_SING
description:
A soothing lullaby is
sung in a calming
voice that puts the
foe into a deep
slumber.

48.name: MOVE_SUPERSONIC
description:
The user generates
odd sound waves from
its body.
It may confuse the
target.

49.name: MOVE_SONIC_BOOM
description:
The foe is hit with a
destructive shock
wave that always
inflicts 20 HP damage.

50.name: MOVE_DISABLE
description:
For several turns,
this move prevents
the foe from using
the move it last
used.

51.name: MOVE_ACID
description:
The foe is attacked
with a spray of harsh
acid. It may also
lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

52.name: MOVE_EMBER
description:
The foe is attacked
with small flames.
The target may also
be left with a burn.

53.name: MOVE_FLAMETHROWER
description:
The foe is scorched
with an intense blast
of fire. The target
may also be left with
a burn.

54.name: MOVE_MIST
description:
The user cloaks its
body with a white mist
that prevents any of
its stats from being
cut for five turns.

55.name: MOVE_WATER_GUN
description:
The foe is blasted
with a forceful shot
of water.

56.name: MOVE_HYDRO_PUMP
description:
The foe is blasted by
a huge volume of
water launched under
great pressure.

57.name: MOVE_SURF
description:
It swamps the entire
battlefield with a
giant wave.
It can also be used
for crossing water.

58.name: MOVE_ICE_BEAM
description:
The foe is struck
with an icy-cold
beam of energy.
It may also freeze
the target solid.

59.name: MOVE_BLIZZARD
description:
A howling blizzard is
summoned to strike
the foe.
It may also freeze
the target solid.

60.name: MOVE_PSYBEAM
description:
The foe is attacked
with a peculiar ray.
It may also leave the
target confused.

61.name: MOVE_BUBBLE_BEAM
description:
A spray of bubbles is
forcefully ejected
at the foe.
It may also lower the
target’s Speed stat.

62.name: MOVE_AURORA_BEAM
description:
The foe is hit with a
rainbow-colored beam.
It may also lower the
target’s Attack
stat.

63.name: MOVE_HYPER_BEAM
description:
The foe is attacked
with a powerful beam.
The user must rest
on the next turn to
regain its energy.

64.name: MOVE_PECK
description:
The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed beak or
horn.

65.name: MOVE_DRILL_PECK
description:
A corkscrewing
attack with the
sharp beak acting
as a drill.

66.name: MOVE_SUBMISSION
description:
The user grabs the
foe and recklessly
dives for the ground.
It also hurts the
user slightly.

67.name: MOVE_LOW_KICK
description:
A powerful low kick
that makes the foe
fall over. It inflicts
greater damage on
heavier foes.

68.name: MOVE_COUNTER
description:
A retaliation move
that counters any
physical attack,
inflicting double the
damage taken.

69.name: MOVE_SEISMIC_TOSS
description:
The foe is thrown
using the power of
gravity. It inflicts
damage equal to
the user’s level.

70.name: MOVE_STRENGTH
description:
The foe is slugged
with a punch thrown
at maximum power.
It can also be used
to move boulders.

71.name: MOVE_ABSORB
description:
A nutrient-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

72.name: MOVE_MEGA_DRAIN
description:
A nutrient-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

73.name: MOVE_LEECH_SEED
description:
A seed is planted on
the foe. It steals
some HP from the foe
to heal the user on
every turn.

74.name: MOVE_GROWTH
description:
The user’s body is
forced to grow all at
once. It raises the
Sp. Atk stat.

75.name: MOVE_RAZOR_LEAF
description:
Sharp-edged leaves
are launched to slash
at the foe. It has a
high critical-hit
ratio.

76.name: MOVE_SOLAR_BEAM
description:
A two-turn attack.
The user gathers
light, then blasts a
bundled beam on the
second turn.

77.name: MOVE_POISON_POWDER
description:
A cloud of poisonous
dust is scattered on
the foe.
It may poison the
target.

78.name: MOVE_STUN_SPORE
description:
The user scatters a
cloud of paralyzing
powder.
It may paralyze the
target.

79.name: MOVE_SLEEP_POWDER
description:
The user scatters a
big cloud of sleep-
inducing dust around
the foe.

80.name: MOVE_PETAL_DANCE
description:
The user attacks by
scattering petals for
two to three turns.
The user then
becomes confused.

81.name: MOVE_STRING_SHOT
description:
The foe is bound with
silk blown from the
user’s mouth.
It reduces the
target’s Speed stat.

82.name: MOVE_DRAGON_RAGE
description:
The foe is stricken
by a shock wave.
This attack always
inflicts 40 HP
damage.

83.name: MOVE_FIRE_SPIN
description:
The foe becomes
trapped within a
fierce vortex of fire
that rages for two
to five turns.

84.name: MOVE_THUNDER_SHOCK
description:
A jolt of electricity
is hurled at the foe
to inflict damage.
It may also leave the
foe paralyzed.

85.name: MOVE_THUNDERBOLT
description:
A strong electric
blast is loosed at
the foe.
It may also leave the
foe paralyzed.

86.name: MOVE_THUNDER_WAVE
description:
A weak electric
charge is launched at
the foe.
It causes paralysis if
it hits.

87.name: MOVE_THUNDER
description:
A wicked thunderbolt
is dropped on the foe
to inflict damage.
It may also leave the
target paralyzed.

88.name: MOVE_ROCK_THROW
description:
The user picks up
and throws a small
rock at the foe to
attack.

89.name: MOVE_EARTHQUAKE
description:
The user sets off an
earthquake that hits
all the Pokémon in
the battle.

90.name: MOVE_FISSURE
description:
The user opens up a
fissure in the ground
and drops the foe in.
The target instantly
faints if it hits.

91.name: MOVE_DIG
description:
The user burrows,
then attacks on the
second turn.
It can also be used
to exit dungeons.

92.name: MOVE_TOXIC
description:
A move that leaves
the target badly
poisoned.
Its poison damage
worsens every turn.

93.name: MOVE_CONFUSION
description:
The foe is hit by a
weak telekinetic
force. It may also
leave the foe
confused.

94.name: MOVE_PSYCHIC
description:
The foe is hit by a
strong telekinetic
force. It may also
reduce the foe’s
Sp. Def stat.

95.name: MOVE_HYPNOSIS
description:
The user employs
hypnotic suggestion
to make the target
fall into a deep
sleep.

96.name: MOVE_MEDITATE
description:
The user meditates
to awaken the power
deep within its body
and raise its Attack
stat.

97.name: MOVE_AGILITY
description:
The user relaxes and
lightens its body to
move faster.
It sharply boosts
the Speed stat.

98.name: MOVE_QUICK_ATTACK
description:
The user lunges at
the foe at a speed
that makes it almost
invisible. It is sure
to strike first.

99.name: MOVE_RAGE
description:
While this move is in
use, it gains attack
power each time the
user is hit in battle.

100.name: MOVE_TELEPORT
description:
Use it to flee from
any wild Pokémon.
It may also be used
to warp to the last
Poké Center visited.

101.name: MOVE_NIGHT_SHADE
description:
The user makes the
foe see a mirage.
It inflicts damage
matching the user’s
level.

102.name: MOVE_MIMIC
description:
The user copies the
move last used by
the foe. The move can
be used for the rest
of the battle.

103.name: MOVE_SCREECH
description:
An earsplitting
screech is emitted to
sharply reduce the
foe’s Defense stat.

104.name: MOVE_DOUBLE_TEAM
description:
By moving rapidly, the
user makes illusory
copies of itself to
raise its evasiveness.

105.name: MOVE_RECOVER
description:
A self-healing move.
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its max HP.

106.name: MOVE_HARDEN
description:
The user stiffens all
the muscles in its
body to raise its
Defense stat.

107.name: MOVE_MINIMIZE
description:
The user compresses
its body to make
itself look smaller.
The user’s evasion
stat is boosted.

108.name: MOVE_SMOKE_SCREEN
description:
The user releases an
obscuring cloud of
smoke or ink.
It reduces the foe’s
accuracy.

109.name: MOVE_CONFUSE_RAY
description:
The foe is exposed
to a sinister ray
that triggers
confusion.

110.name: MOVE_WITHDRAW
description:
The user withdraws
its body into its hard
shell, raising its
Defense stat.

111.name: MOVE_DEFENSE_CURL
description:
The user curls up to
conceal weak spots
and raise its Defense
stat.

112.name: MOVE_BARRIER
description:
The user throws up a
sturdy wall that
sharply raises its
Defense stat.

113.name: MOVE_LIGHT_SCREEN
description:
A wondrous wall of
light is put up to
suppress damage from
special attacks for
five turns.

114.name: MOVE_HAZE
description:
The user creates a
haze that eliminates
every stat change
among all the Pokémon
engaged in battle.

115.name: MOVE_REFLECT
description:
A wondrous wall of
light is put up to
suppress damage from
physical attacks for
five turns.

116.name: MOVE_FOCUS_ENERGY
description:
The user takes a
deep breath and
focuses to raise the
critical-hit ratio of
its attacks.

117.name: MOVE_BIDE
description:
The user endures
attacks for two
turns, then strikes
back to cause double
the damage taken.

118.name: MOVE_METRONOME
description:
The user waggles a
finger and stimulates
the brain into
randomly using nearly
any move.

119.name: MOVE_MIRROR_MOVE
description:
The user counters
the foe by mimicking
the move last used
by the foe.

120.name: MOVE_SELFDESTRUCT
description:
The user blows up to
inflict damage on all
Pokémon in battle.
The user faints upon
using this move.

121.name: MOVE_EGG_BOMB
description:
A large egg is hurled
with maximum force at
the foe to inflict
damage.

122.name: MOVE_LICK
description:
The foe is licked with
a long tongue, causing
damage.
It may also paralyze
the target.

123.name: MOVE_SMOG
description:
The foe is attacked
with a discharge of
filthy gases.
It may also poison
the target.

124.name: MOVE_SLUDGE
description:
Unsanitary sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may also poison
the target.

125.name: MOVE_BONE_CLUB
description:
The user clubs the
foe with a bone.
It may also make the
target flinch.

126.name: MOVE_FIRE_BLAST
description:
The foe is attacked
with an intense blast
of all-consuming fire.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

127.name: MOVE_WATERFALL
description:
The user charges the
foe at an awesome
speed.
It can also be used
to climb a waterfall.

128.name: MOVE_CLAMP
description:
The foe is clamped
and squeezed by
the user’s very thick
and sturdy shell for
two to five turns.

129.name: MOVE_SWIFT
description:
Star-shaped rays are
shot at the foe.
This attack never
misses.

130.name: MOVE_SKULL_BASH
description:
The user tucks in its
head to raise its
Defense in the first
turn, then rams the
foe on the next turn.

131.name: MOVE_SPIKE_CANNON
description:
Sharp spikes are
fired at the foe to
strike two to five
times in rapid
succession.

132.name: MOVE_CONSTRICT
description:
The foe is attacked
with long, creeping
tentacles or vines.
It may also lower the
target’s Speed.

133.name: MOVE_AMNESIA
description:
The user temporarily
empties its mind to
forget its concerns.
It sharply raises the
user’s Sp. Def stat.

134.name: MOVE_KINESIS
description:
The user distracts
the foe by bending a
spoon.
It may lower the
target’s accuracy.

135.name: MOVE_SOFTBOILED
description:
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its maximum HP.
It may also be used
to heal an ally’s HP.

136.name: MOVE_HI_JUMP_KICK
description:
The foe is attacked
with a knee kick from
a jump. If it misses,
the user is hurt
instead.

137.name: MOVE_GLARE
description:
The user intimidates
the foe with the
pattern on its belly
to cause paralysis.

138.name: MOVE_DREAM_EATER
description:
An attack that works
only on a sleeping
foe. It absorbs half
the damage caused to
heal the user’s HP.

139.name: MOVE_POISON_GAS
description:
A cloud of poison gas
is sprayed in the
foe’s face.
It may poison the
target.

140.name: MOVE_BARRAGE
description:
Round objects are
hurled at the foe to
strike two to five
times in a row.

141.name: MOVE_LEECH_LIFE
description:
A blood-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

142.name: MOVE_LOVELY_KISS
description:
With a scary face,
the user forces a
kiss on the foe.
It may make the
target fall asleep.

143.name: MOVE_SKY_ATTACK
description:
A second-turn attack
move with a high
critical-hit ratio.
It may also make the
target flinch.

144.name: MOVE_TRANSFORM
description:
The user transforms
into a copy of the
foe right down to
having the same move
set.

145.name: MOVE_BUBBLE
description:
A spray of countless
bubbles is jetted at
the foe.
It may also lower the
target’s Speed stat.

146.name: MOVE_DIZZY_PUNCH
description:
The foe is hit with
rhythmically launched
punches that may also
leave it confused.

147.name: MOVE_SPORE
description:
The user scatters
bursts of spores
that induce sleep.

148.name: MOVE_FLASH
description:
The user flashes a
light that cuts the
foe’s accuracy.
It can also be used
to illuminate caves.

149.name: MOVE_PSYWAVE
description:
The foe is attacked
with an odd, hot
energy wave.
The attack varies in
intensity.

150.name: MOVE_SPLASH
description:
The user just flops
and splashes around
to no effect at all...

151.name: MOVE_ACID_ARMOR
description:
The user alters its
cellular structure to
liquefy itself,
sharply raising its
Defense stat.

152.name: MOVE_CRABHAMMER
description:
The foe is hammered
with a large pincer.
This move has a high
critical-hit ratio.

153.name: MOVE_EXPLOSION
description:
The user explodes to
inflict damage on all
Pokémon in battle.
The user faints upon
using this move.

154.name: MOVE_FURY_SWIPES
description:
The foe is raked with
sharp claws or
scythes for two to
five times in quick
succession.

155.name: MOVE_BONEMERANG
description:
The user throws the
bone it holds. The
bone loops to hit the
foe twice, coming and
going.

156.name: MOVE_REST
description:
The user goes to
sleep for two turns.
It fully restores the
user’s HP and heals
any status problem.

157.name: MOVE_ROCK_SLIDE
description:
Large boulders are
hurled at the foe to
inflict damage.
It may also make the
target flinch.

158.name: MOVE_HYPER_FANG
description:
The user bites hard
on the foe with its
sharp front fangs.
It may also make the
target flinch.

159.name: MOVE_SHARPEN
description:
The user reduces its
polygon count to
make itself more
jagged, raising the
Attack stat.

160.name: MOVE_CONVERSION
description:
The user changes its
type to become the
same type as one of
its moves.

161.name: MOVE_TRI_ATTACK
description:
The user strikes with
a simultaneous three-
beam attack. May also
paralyze, burn, or
freeze the target.

162.name: MOVE_SUPER_FANG
description:
The user chomps hard
on the foe with its
sharp front fangs.
It cuts the target’s
HP to half.

163.name: MOVE_SLASH
description:
The foe is attacked
with a slash of
claws, etc.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

164.name: MOVE_SUBSTITUTE
description:
The user makes a
copy of itself using
some of its HP.
The copy serves as
the user’s decoy.

165.name: MOVE_STRUGGLE
description:
An attack that is
used in desperation
only if the user has
no PP. It also hurts
the user slightly.

166.name: MOVE_SKETCH
description:
It enables the user
to learn a move used
by the foe.
Once used, the move
Sketch disappears.

167.name: MOVE_TRIPLE_KICK
description:
A consecutive three-
kick attack that
becomes more
powerful with each 
successive hit.

168.name: MOVE_THIEF
description:
The user attacks and
steals the foe’s held
item simultaneously.
It can’t steal if the
user holds an item.

169.name: MOVE_SPIDER_WEB
description:
The user ensnares
the foe with a thin,
gooey silk so it can’t
flee from battle.

170.name: MOVE_MIND_READER
description:
The user senses the
foe’s movements
with its mind to
ensure its next
attack does not miss.

171.name: MOVE_NIGHTMARE
description:
A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn.

172.name: MOVE_FLAME_WHEEL
description:
The user cloaks
itself in fire and
charges at the foe.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

173.name: MOVE_SNORE
description:
An attack that can
be used only if the
user is asleep. The
harsh noise may also
make the foe flinch.

174.name: MOVE_CURSE
description:
A move that works
differently for the
Ghost type than for
all the other types.

175.name: MOVE_FLAIL
description:
The user flails about
aimlessly to attack.
It becomes more
powerful the less HP
the user has.

176.name: MOVE_CONVERSION_2
description:
The user changes its
type to make itself
resistant to the type
of the attack it
last took.

177.name: MOVE_AEROBLAST
description:
A vortex of air is
shot at the foe to
inflict damage.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

178.name: MOVE_COTTON_SPORE
description:
The user releases
cottonlike spores
that cling to the
foe, sharply reducing
its Speed stat.

179.name: MOVE_REVERSAL
description:
An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has.

180.name: MOVE_SPITE
description:
The user looses its
grudge on the move
last used by the foe
by cutting 4 PP from
it.

181.name: MOVE_POWDER_SNOW
description:
The user attacks with
a chilling gust of
powdery snow.
It may also freeze
the target.

182.name: MOVE_PROTECT
description:
It enables the user
to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing
rises if it is used in
succession.

183.name: MOVE_MACH_PUNCH
description:
The user throws a
punch at blinding
speed.
It is certain to
strike first.

184.name: MOVE_SCARY_FACE
description:
The user frightens
the foe with a scary
face to sharply
reduce its Speed
stat.

185.name: MOVE_FAINT_ATTACK
description:
The user draws up to
the foe disarmingly,
then throws a sucker
punch.
It hits without fail.

186.name: MOVE_SWEET_KISS
description:
The user kisses the
foe with a sweet,
angelic cuteness that
causes confusion.

187.name: MOVE_BELLY_DRUM
description:
The user maximizes
its Attack stat in
exchange for HP
equal to half its max
HP.

188.name: MOVE_SLUDGE_BOMB
description:
The user attacks by
hurling filthy sludge
at the foe.
It may also poison
the target.

189.name: MOVE_MUD_SLAP
description:
The user hurls mud in
the foe’s face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy.

190.name: MOVE_OCTAZOOKA
description:
The user attacks by
spraying ink in the
foe’s face or eyes.
It may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

191.name: MOVE_SPIKES
description:
The user lays a trap
of spikes at the
foe’s feet. The trap
hurts foes that
switch into battle.

192.name: MOVE_ZAP_CANNON
description:
The user fires an
electric blast like a
cannon to inflict
damage and cause
paralysis.

193.name: MOVE_FORESIGHT
description:
Enables the user to
hit a Ghost type with
any type of move. It
also enables the user
to hit an evasive foe.

194.name: MOVE_DESTINY_BOND
description:
When this move is
used, if the user
faints, the foe that
landed the knockout
hit also faints.

195.name: MOVE_PERISH_SONG
description:
Any Pokémon that
hears this song
faints in three turns
unless it switches
out of battle.

196.name: MOVE_ICY_WIND
description:
The user attacks with
a gust of chilled air.
It also lowers the
target’s Speed stat.

197.name: MOVE_DETECT
description:
It enables the user
to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing
rises if it is used in
succession.

198.name: MOVE_BONE_RUSH
description:
The user strikes at
the foe with a hard
bone two to five
times in a row.

199.name: MOVE_LOCK_ON
description:
The user takes sure
aim at the foe.
It ensures the next
attack does not fail
to hit the target.

200.name: MOVE_OUTRAGE
description:
The user rampages
and attacks for two
to three turns.
However, it then
becomes confused.

201.name: MOVE_SANDSTORM
description:
A five-turn sand-
storm is summoned
to hurt all combatant
types except Rock, 
Ground, and Steel.

202.name: MOVE_GIGA_DRAIN
description:
A nutrient-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

203.name: MOVE_ENDURE
description:
The user endures any
attack, leaving 1 HP.
Its chance of failing
rises if it is used in
succession.

204.name: MOVE_CHARM
description:
The user charmingly
stares at the foe,
making it less wary.
The target’s Attack
is sharply lowered.

205.name: MOVE_ROLLOUT
description:
The user continually
rolls into the foe
over five turns. It
becomes stronger
each time it hits.

206.name: MOVE_FALSE_SWIPE
description:
A restrained attack
that prevents the
foe from fainting.
The target is left
with at least 1 HP.

207.name: MOVE_SWAGGER
description:
The user enrages the
foe into confusion.
However, it also
sharply raises the
foe’s Attack stat.

208.name: MOVE_MILK_DRINK
description:
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its maximum HP.
It may also be used
to heal an ally’s HP.

209.name: MOVE_SPARK
description:
The user throws an
electrically charged
tackle at the foe.
It may also leave the
target paralyzed.

210.name: MOVE_FURY_CUTTER
description:
The foe is slashed
with scythes or
claws. Its power
increases if it hits
in succession.

211.name: MOVE_STEEL_WING
description:
The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise the
user’s Defense stat.

212.name: MOVE_MEAN_LOOK
description:
The user affixes the
foe with a dark,
arresting look.
The target becomes
unable to flee.

213.name: MOVE_ATTRACT
description:
If it is the opposite
gender of the user,
the foe becomes
infatuated and less
likely to attack.

214.name: MOVE_SLEEP_TALK
description:
While it is asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows.

215.name: MOVE_HEAL_BELL
description:
The user makes a
soothing bell chime
to heal the status
problems of all the
party Pokémon.

216.name: MOVE_RETURN
description:
A full-power attack
that grows more
powerful the more
the user likes its
Trainer.

217.name: MOVE_PRESENT
description:
The user attacks by
giving the foe a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however.

218.name: MOVE_FRUSTRATION
description:
A full-power attack
that grows more
powerful the less
the user likes its
Trainer.

219.name: MOVE_SAFEGUARD
description:
The user creates a
protective field that
prevents status
problems for five
turns.

220.name: MOVE_PAIN_SPLIT
description:
The user adds its HP
to the foe’s HP, then
equally shares the
combined HP with the
foe.

221.name: MOVE_SACRED_FIRE
description:
The foe is razed with
a mystical fire of
great intensity.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

222.name: MOVE_MAGNITUDE
description:
The user looses a
ground-shaking quake
affecting everyone in
battle. Its power
varies.

223.name: MOVE_DYNAMIC_PUNCH
description:
The foe is punched
with the user’s full,
concentrated power.
It confuses the foe
if it hits.

224.name: MOVE_MEGAHORN
description:
Utilizing its tough
and impressive
horn, the user
rams into the foe 
with no letup.

225.name: MOVE_DRAGON_BREATH
description:
The user exhales
a mighty gust that
inflicts damage.
It may also paralyze
the target.

226.name: MOVE_BATON_PASS
description:
The user switches
places with a party
Pokémon in waiting,
passing along any
stat changes.

227.name: MOVE_ENCORE
description:
The user compels the
foe to keep using
only the move it last
used for three to
seven turns.

228.name: MOVE_PURSUIT
description:
An attack move that
inflicts double damage
if used on a foe that
is switching out of
battle.

229.name: MOVE_RAPID_SPIN
description:
A spin attack that
can also eliminate
such moves as Bind,
Wrap, Leech Seed,
and Spikes.

230.name: MOVE_SWEET_SCENT
description:
A sweet scent that
lowers the foe’s
evasiveness. It also
lures wild Pokémon
if used in grass, etc.

231.name: MOVE_IRON_TAIL
description:
The foe is slammed
with a steel-hard
tail. It may also
lower the target’s
Defense stat.

232.name: MOVE_METAL_CLAW
description:
The foe is raked
with steel claws.
It may also raise the
user’s Attack stat.

233.name: MOVE_VITAL_THROW
description:
The user allows the
foe to attack first.
In return, this throw
move is guaranteed
not to miss.

234.name: MOVE_MORNING_SUN
description:
The user restores its
own HP.
The amount of HP
regained varies with
the weather.

235.name: MOVE_SYNTHESIS
description:
The user restores its
own HP.
The amount of HP
regained varies with
the weather.

236.name: MOVE_MOONLIGHT
description:
The user restores its
own HP.
The amount of HP
regained varies with
the weather.

237.name: MOVE_HIDDEN_POWER
description:
A unique attack that
varies in type and
intensity depending
on the Pokémon using
it.

238.name: MOVE_CROSS_CHOP
description:
The user delivers a
double chop with its
forearms crossed.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

239.name: MOVE_TWISTER
description:
The user whips up a
vicious twister to
tear at the foe.
It may also make the
foe flinch.

240.name: MOVE_RAIN_DANCE
description:
The user summons a
heavy rain that falls
for five turns,
powering up Water-
type moves.

241.name: MOVE_SUNNY_DAY
description:
The user intensifies
the sun for five
turns, powering up
Fire-type moves.

242.name: MOVE_CRUNCH
description:
The user crunches up
the foe with sharp
fangs. It may also
lower the target’s
Defense stat.

243.name: MOVE_MIRROR_COAT
description:
A retaliation move
that counters any
special attack,
inflicting double the
damage taken.

244.name: MOVE_PSYCH_UP
description:
The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe.

245.name: MOVE_EXTREME_SPEED
description:
The user charges the
foe at blinding speed.
This attack always
goes before any
other move.

246.name: MOVE_ANCIENT_POWER
description:
The user attacks with
a prehistoric power.
It may also raise all
the user’s stats at
once.

247.name: MOVE_SHADOW_BALL
description:
The user hurls a
shadowy blob at the
foe. It may also
lower the foe’s
Sp. Def stat.

248.name: MOVE_FUTURE_SIGHT
description:
Two turns after this
move is used, the foe
is attacked with a
hunk of psychic
energy.

249.name: MOVE_ROCK_SMASH
description:
The user slugs the
foe with a shattering
punch.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.

250.name: MOVE_WHIRLPOOL
description:
The user traps the
foe inside a fast,
vicious whirlpool that
lasts for two to five
turns.

251.name: MOVE_BEAT_UP
description:
The user gets all the
party Pokémon to
attack the foe. The
more party Pokémon,
the more damage.

252.name: MOVE_FAKE_OUT
description:
An attack that hits
first and makes the
target flinch.
This move works only
on the first turn.

253.name: MOVE_UPROAR
description:
The user attacks in
an uproar for two to
five turns. Over that
time, no one can fall
asleep.

254.name: MOVE_STOCKPILE
description:
The user charges
up power, and raises
both its Defense and
Sp. Def. The move can
be used three times.

255.name: MOVE_SPIT_UP
description:
The power stored
using the move
Stockpile is released
at once in an attack.

256.name: MOVE_SWALLOW
description:
The power stored
using the move
Stockpile is absorbed
by the user to heal
its HP.

257.name: MOVE_HEAT_WAVE
description:
The user exhales a
heated breath on the
foe to attack. It may
also leave the target
with a burn.

258.name: MOVE_HAIL
description:
The user summons a
hailstorm lasting five
turns. It damages all
Pokémon except the
Ice type.

259.name: MOVE_TORMENT
description:
The user torments
and enrages the foe,
making it incapable of
using the same move
twice in a row.

260.name: MOVE_FLATTER
description:
Flattery is used to
confuse the foe.
However, it also
raises the target’s
Sp. Atk stat.

261.name: MOVE_WILL_O_WISP
description:
The user shoots a
sinister, bluish white
flame at the foe to
inflict a burn.

262.name: MOVE_MEMENTO
description:
The user faints upon
using this move.
In return, it sharply
lowers the target’s
Attack and Sp. Atk.

263.name: MOVE_FACADE
description:
An attack move that
doubles its power if
the user is poisoned,
paralyzed, or has a
burn.

264.name: MOVE_FOCUS_PUNCH
description:
The user focuses its
mind before launching
a punch. It will fail
if the user is hit
before it is used.

265.name: MOVE_SMELLING_SALT
description:
This attack inflicts
double damage on a
paralyzed foe. It
also cures the foe’s
paralysis, however.

266.name: MOVE_FOLLOW_ME
description:
The user draws
attention to itself,
making all foes take
aim only at the user.

267.name: MOVE_NATURE_POWER
description:
An attack that makes
use of nature’s
power. Its effects
vary depending on the
user’s environment.

268.name: MOVE_CHARGE
description:
The user boosts the
power of the Electric
move it uses next.
It also raises the
user’s Sp. Def stat.

269.name: MOVE_TAUNT
description:
The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use only
attack moves for two
to four turns.

270.name: MOVE_HELPING_HAND
description:
A move that boosts
the power of the
ally’s attack in a
Double Battle.

271.name: MOVE_TRICK
description:
The user catches the
foe off guard and
swaps the foe’s held
item with its own.

272.name: MOVE_ROLE_PLAY
description:
The user mimics the
foe completely,
copying the foe’s
natural ability.

273.name: MOVE_WISH
description:
A self-healing move.
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its maximum HP
in the next turn.

274.name: MOVE_ASSIST
description:
The user hurriedly
and randomly uses a
move among those
known by other
Pokémon in the party.

275.name: MOVE_INGRAIN
description:
The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
Because it is rooted,
it can’t switch out.

276.name: MOVE_SUPERPOWER
description:
The user attacks the
foe with great power.
However, it also
lowers the user’s
Attack and Defense.

277.name: MOVE_MAGIC_COAT
description:
A barrier reflects
back to the foe
moves like Leech
Seed and moves
that damage status.

278.name: MOVE_RECYCLE
description:
The user recycles a
single-use item that
has been used in
battle so it can be
used again.

279.name: MOVE_REVENGE
description:
An attack move that
inflicts double the
damage if the user
has been hurt by the
foe in the same turn.

280.name: MOVE_BRICK_BREAK
description:
The user attacks with
tough fists, etc. It
can also break any
barrier such as Light
Screen and Reflect.

281.name: MOVE_YAWN
description:
The user lets loose a
huge yawn that lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn.

282.name: MOVE_KNOCK_OFF
description:
The user slaps down
the foe’s held item,
preventing the item
from being used
during the battle.

283.name: MOVE_ENDEAVOR
description:
An attack move that
cuts down the foe’s
HP to equal the
user’s HP.

284.name: MOVE_ERUPTION
description:
The user attacks in
an explosive fury.
The lower the user’s
HP, the less powerful
this attack becomes.

285.name: MOVE_SKILL_SWAP
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
exchange abilities
with the foe.

286.name: MOVE_IMPRISON
description:
If the foe knows any
move also known by
the user, the foe
is prevented
from using it.

287.name: MOVE_REFRESH
description:
The user rests
to cure itself of a
poisoning, burn, or
paralysis.

288.name: MOVE_GRUDGE
description:
If the user faints,
the user’s grudge
fully depletes the PP
of the foe’s move
that knocked it out.

289.name: MOVE_SNATCH
description:
The user steals the
effects of any
healing or stat-
changing move the foe
attempts to use.

290.name: MOVE_SECRET_POWER
description:
The user attacks with
a secret power. Its
added effects vary
depending on the
user’s environment.

291.name: MOVE_DIVE
description:
A two-turn attack.
The user dives
underwater on the
first turn, then hits
on the next turn.

292.name: MOVE_ARM_THRUST
description:
The user looses a
flurry of open-palmed
arm thrusts that hit
two to five times in a
row.

293.name: MOVE_CAMOUFLAGE
description:
The user’s type is
changed depending on
its environment, such
as at water’s edge, in
grass, or in a cave.

294.name: MOVE_TAIL_GLOW
description:
The user stares at
flashing lights to
focus its mind,
sharply raising its
Sp. Atk stat.

295.name: MOVE_LUSTER_PURGE
description:
The user looses a
damaging burst of
light. It may also
reduce the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

296.name: MOVE_MIST_BALL
description:
A mistlike flurry of
down envelops and
damages the foe. It
may also lower the
target’s Sp. Atk.

297.name: MOVE_FEATHER_DANCE
description:
The user covers the
foe with a mass of
down that sharply
lowers the Attack
stat.

298.name: MOVE_TEETER_DANCE
description:
The user performs a
wobbly dance that
confuses all the
Pokémon in battle.

299.name: MOVE_BLAZE_KICK
description:
The user launches a
kick with a high
critical-hit ratio.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

300.name: MOVE_MUD_SPORT
description:
The user covers
itself with mud. It
weakens Electric-
type moves while the
user is in the battle.

301.name: MOVE_ICE_BALL
description:
The user continually
rolls into the foe
over five turns. It
becomes stronger
each time it hits.

302.name: MOVE_NEEDLE_ARM
description:
The user attacks by
wildly swinging its
thorny arms.
It may also make the
target flinch.

303.name: MOVE_SLACK_OFF
description:
The user slacks off,
restoring its own HP
by up to half of its
maximum HP.

304.name: MOVE_HYPER_VOICE
description:
The user lets loose
a horribly echoing
shout with the
power to inflict
damage.

305.name: MOVE_POISON_FANG
description:
The user bites the
foe with toxic fangs.
It may also leave the
foe badly poisoned.

306.name: MOVE_CRUSH_CLAW
description:
The user slashes the
foe with hard and
sharp claws.
It may also lower the
target’s Defense.

307.name: MOVE_BLAST_BURN
description:
The foe is razed by
a fiery explosion.
The user must rest
on the next turn,
however.

308.name: MOVE_HYDRO_CANNON
description:
The foe is hit with
a watery blast.
The user must rest
on the next turn,
however.

309.name: MOVE_METEOR_MASH
description:
The foe is hit with a
hard punch fired
like a meteor.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack.

310.name: MOVE_ASTONISH
description:
The user attacks the
foe while shouting in
a startling fashion.
It may also make the
target flinch.

311.name: MOVE_WEATHER_BALL
description:
An attack move that
varies in power and
type depending on
the weather.

312.name: MOVE_AROMATHERAPY
description:
The user releases a
soothing scent that
heals all status
problems affecting
the user’s party.

313.name: MOVE_FAKE_TEARS
description:
The user feigns
crying to make the
foe feel flustered,
sharply lowering its
Sp. Def stat.

314.name: MOVE_AIR_CUTTER
description:
The user launches
razorlike wind to
slash the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

315.name: MOVE_OVERHEAT
description:
The user attacks the
foe at full power.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

316.name: MOVE_ODOR_SLEUTH
description:
Enables the user to
hit a Ghost type with
any type of move. It
also enables the user
to hit an evasive foe.

317.name: MOVE_ROCK_TOMB
description:
Boulders are hurled
at the foe. It also
lowers the foe’s
Speed by preventing
its movement.

318.name: MOVE_SILVER_WIND
description:
The foe is attacked
with powdery scales
blown by wind.
It may also raise all
the user’s stats.

319.name: MOVE_METAL_SOUND
description:
A horrible sound like
scraping metal is
emitted to sharply
reduce the foe’s
Sp. Def stat.

320.name: MOVE_GRASS_WHISTLE
description:
The user plays a
pleasant melody that
lulls the foe into a
deep sleep.

321.name: MOVE_TICKLE
description:
The user tickles the
foe into laughing,
reducing its Attack
and Defense stats.

322.name: MOVE_COSMIC_POWER
description:
The user absorbs a
mystical power from
space to raise its
Defense and Sp. Def
stats.

323.name: MOVE_WATER_SPOUT
description:
The user spouts
water to damage the
foe. The lower the
user’s HP, the less
powerful it becomes.

324.name: MOVE_SIGNAL_BEAM
description:
The user attacks with
a sinister beam of
light. It may also
confuse the target.

325.name: MOVE_SHADOW_PUNCH
description:
The user throws a
punch at the foe from
the shadows.
The punch lands
without fail.

326.name: MOVE_EXTRASENSORY
description:
The user attacks with
an odd, unseeable
power.
It may also make the
foe flinch.

327.name: MOVE_SKY_UPPERCUT
description:
The user attacks the
foe with an uppercut
thrown skyward
with force.

328.name: MOVE_SAND_TOMB
description:
The user traps the
foe inside a harshly
raging sandstorm for
two to five turns.

329.name: MOVE_SHEER_COLD
description:
The foe is attacked
with a blast of
absolute-zero cold.
The foe instantly
faints if it hits.

330.name: MOVE_MUDDY_WATER
description:
The user attacks by
shooting out muddy
water.
It may also lower the
foe’s accuracy.

331.name: MOVE_BULLET_SEED
description:
The user forcefully
shoots seeds at the
foe. Two to five
seeds are shot in
rapid succession.

332.name: MOVE_AERIAL_ACE
description:
The user confounds
the foe with speed,
then slashes.
The attack lands
without fail.

333.name: MOVE_ICICLE_SPEAR
description:
The user launches
sharp icicles at the
foe. It strikes two
to five times in a
row.

334.name: MOVE_IRON_DEFENSE
description:
The user hardens
its body’s surface
like iron, sharply
raising its Defense
stat.

335.name: MOVE_BLOCK
description:
The user blocks the
foe’s way with arms
spread wide to
prevent escape.

336.name: MOVE_HOWL
description:
The user howls loudly
to raise its spirit,
boosting its Attack
stat.

337.name: MOVE_DRAGON_CLAW
description:
The user slashes the
foe with huge, sharp
claws.

338.name: MOVE_FRENZY_PLANT
description:
The foe is slammed
with an enormous
tree.
The user can’t move
on the next turn.

339.name: MOVE_BULK_UP
description:
The user tenses its
muscles to bulk up
its body, boosting
both its Attack and
Defense stats.

340.name: MOVE_BOUNCE
description:
The user bounces up
high, then drops on
the foe on the second
turn. It may also
paralyze the foe.

341.name: MOVE_MUD_SHOT
description:
The user attacks by
hurling a blob of mud
at the foe.
It also reduces the
target’s Speed.

342.name: MOVE_POISON_TAIL
description:
An attack with a
high critical-hit
ratio. This tail 
attack may also 
poison the foe.

343.name: MOVE_COVET
description:
The user endearingly
approaches the foe,
then steals the item
the foe is holding.

344.name: MOVE_VOLT_TACKLE
description:
The user electrifies
itself, then charges
at the foe. It causes
considerable damage
to the user as well.

345.name: MOVE_MAGICAL_LEAF
description:
The user scatters
curious leaves that
chase the foe.
This attack will not
miss.

346.name: MOVE_WATER_SPORT
description:
The user soaks itself
with water. The move
weakens Fire-type
moves while the user
is in the battle.

347.name: MOVE_CALM_MIND
description:
The user quietly
focuses its mind and
calms its spirit to
raise its Sp. Atk and
Sp. Def stats.

348.name: MOVE_LEAF_BLADE
description:
The foe is slashed
with a sharp leaf.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

349.name: MOVE_DRAGON_DANCE
description:
The user vigorously
performs a mystic,
powerful dance that
boosts its Attack and
Speed stats.

350.name: MOVE_ROCK_BLAST
description:
The user hurls hard
rocks at the foe.
Two to five rocks are
launched in quick
succession.

351.name: MOVE_SHOCK_WAVE
description:
The user strikes the
foe with a quick jolt
of electricity.
This attack cannot be
evaded.

352.name: MOVE_WATER_PULSE
description:
The user attacks the
foe with a pulsing
blast of water.
It may also confuse
the foe.

353.name: MOVE_DOOM_DESIRE
description:
Two turns after this
move is used, the
user blasts the foe
with a concentrated
bundle of light.

354.name: MOVE_PSYCHO_BOOST
description:
The user attacks the
foe at full power.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

355.name: MOVE_ROOST
description:
The user lands and
rests its body.
It restores the
user’s HP by up to
half of its max HP.

356.name: MOVE_GRAVITY
description:
Gravity is intensified
for five turns, making
moves involving flying
unusable and
negating Levitation.

357.name: MOVE_MIRACLE_EYE
description:
Enables the user to
hit a Dark type with
any type of move. It
also enables the user
to hit an evasive foe.

358.name: MOVE_WAKE_UP_SLAP
description:
This attack inflicts
high damage on a
sleeping foe. It
also wakes the foe
up, however.

359.name: MOVE_HAMMER_ARM
description:
The user swings and
hits with its strong
and heavy fist.
It lowers the user’s
Speed, however.

360.name: MOVE_GYRO_BALL
description:
The user tackles the
foe with a high-speed
spin. The slower the
user, the greater
the damage.

361.name: MOVE_HEALING_WISH
description:
The user faints. In
return, the Pokémon
taking its place will
have its HP restored
and status cured.

362.name: MOVE_BRINE
description:
If the foe’s HP is
down to about half,
this attack will hit
with double the
power.

363.name: MOVE_NATURAL_GIFT
description:
The user draws power
to attack by using
its held Berry.
The Berry determines
its type and power.

364.name: MOVE_FEINT
description:
An attack that hits a
foe using Protect or
Detect. It also lifts
the effects of those
moves.

365.name: MOVE_PLUCK
description:
The user pecks the
foe. If the foe is
holding a Berry, the
user plucks it and
gains its effect.

366.name: MOVE_TAILWIND
description:
The user whips up a
turbulent whirlwind
that ups the Speed
of all party Pokémon
for three turns.

367.name: MOVE_ACUPRESSURE
description:
The user applies
pressure to stress
points, sharply
boosting one of its
stats.

368.name: MOVE_METAL_BURST
description:
The user retaliates
against the foe that
last inflicted damage
on it with much
greater power.

369.name: MOVE_U_TURN
description:
After making its
attack, the user
rushes back to switch
places with a party
Pokémon in waiting.

370.name: MOVE_CLOSE_COMBAT
description:
The user fights the
foe in close without
guarding itself. It
also cuts the user’s
Defense and Sp. Def.

371.name: MOVE_PAYBACK
description:
If the user can use
this attack after the
foe attacks, its
power is doubled.

372.name: MOVE_ASSURANCE
description:
If the foe has
already taken some
damage in the same
turn, this attack’s
power is doubled.

373.name: MOVE_EMBARGO
description:
It prevents the foe
from using its held
item. Its Trainer is
also prevented from
using items on it.

374.name: MOVE_FLING
description:
The user flings its
held item at the foe
to attack. Its power
and effects depend
on the item.

375.name: MOVE_PSYCHO_SHIFT
description:
Using its psychic
power of suggestion,
the user transfers
its status problems
to the target.

376.name: MOVE_TRUMP_CARD
description:
The fewer PP this
move has, the more
power it has for
attack.

377.name: MOVE_HEAL_BLOCK
description:
The user prevents
the foe from using
any HP-recovery
moves for five turns.

378.name: MOVE_WRING_OUT
description:
The user powerfully
wrings the foe.
The more HP the foe
has, the greater this
attack’s power.

379.name: MOVE_POWER_TRICK
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch its Attack
with its Defense
stat.

380.name: MOVE_GASTRO_ACID
description:
The user hurls up its
stomach acids on
the foe. The fluid
eliminates the effect
of the foe’s ability.

381.name: MOVE_LUCKY_CHANT
description:
The user chants an
incantation toward
the sky, preventing
the foe from landing
critical hits.

382.name: MOVE_ME_FIRST
description:
The user tries to cut
ahead of the foe to
steal and use the
foe’s intended move
with greater power.

383.name: MOVE_COPYCAT
description:
The user mimics the
move used immediately
before it. The move
fails if no other move
has been used yet.

384.name: MOVE_POWER_SWAP
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Attack and
Sp. Atk with the foe.

385.name: MOVE_GUARD_SWAP
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Defense and
Sp. Def with the foe.

386.name: MOVE_PUNISHMENT
description:
This attack’s power
increases the more
the foe has powered
up with stat changes.

387.name: MOVE_LAST_RESORT
description:
This move can be used
only after the user
has used all the
other moves it knows
in the battle.

388.name: MOVE_WORRY_SEED
description:
A seed that causes
worry is planted on
the foe. It prevents
sleep by making its
ability Insomnia.

389.name: MOVE_SUCKER_PUNCH
description:
This move enables the
user to attack first.
It fails if the foe is
not readying an
attack, however.

390.name: MOVE_TOXIC_SPIKES
description:
The user lays a trap
of poison spikes at
the foe’s feet. They
poison foes that
switch into battle.

391.name: MOVE_HEART_SWAP
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch stat changes
with the foe.

392.name: MOVE_AQUA_RING
description:
The user envelops
itself in a veil made
of water. It regains
some HP on every
turn.

393.name: MOVE_MAGNET_RISE
description:
The user levitates
using electrically
generated magnetism
for five turns.

394.name: MOVE_FLARE_BLITZ
description:
The user cloaks
itself in fire and
charges at the foe.
The user sustains
serious damage, too.

395.name: MOVE_FORCE_PALM
description:
The foe is attacked
with a shock wave.
It may also leave the
target paralyzed.

396.name: MOVE_AURA_SPHERE
description:
The user looses a
blast of aura power
from deep within its
body. This move is
certain to hit.

397.name: MOVE_ROCK_POLISH
description:
The user polishes its
body to reduce drag.
It can sharply raise
the Speed stat.

398.name: MOVE_POISON_JAB
description:
The foe is stabbed
with a tentacle or
arm steeped in
poison. It may also
poison the foe.

399.name: MOVE_DARK_PULSE
description:
The user releases a
horrible aura imbued
with dark thoughts.
It may also make the
target flinch.

400.name: MOVE_NIGHT_SLASH
description:
The user slashes the
foe the instant an
opportunity arises.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

401.name: MOVE_AQUA_TAIL
description:
The user attacks by
swinging its tail as if
it were a vicious wave
in a raging storm.

402.name: MOVE_SEED_BOMB
description:
The user slams a
barrage of hard-
shelled seeds
down on the foe
from above.

403.name: MOVE_AIR_SLASH
description:
The user attacks with
a blade of air that
slices even the sky.
It may also make the
target flinch.

404.name: MOVE_X_SCISSOR
description:
The user slashes at
the foe by crossing
its scythes or claws
as if they were a pair
of scissors.

405.name: MOVE_BUG_BUZZ
description:
The user vibrates its
wings to generate a
damaging sound wave.
It may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def stat.

406.name: MOVE_DRAGON_PULSE
description:
The foe is attacked
with a shock wave
generated by the
user’s gaping mouth.

407.name: MOVE_DRAGON_RUSH
description:
The user tackles the
foe while exhibiting
overwhelming menace.
It may also make the
target flinch.

408.name: MOVE_POWER_GEM
description:
The user attacks with
a ray of light that
sparkles as if it were
made of gemstones.

409.name: MOVE_DRAIN_PUNCH
description:
An energy-draining
punch. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

410.name: MOVE_VACUUM_WAVE
description:
The user whirls its
fists to send a wave
of pure vacuum at
the foe. This move
always goes first.

411.name: MOVE_FOCUS_BLAST
description:
The user heightens
its mental focus and
unleashes its power.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

412.name: MOVE_ENERGY_BALL
description:
The user draws power
from nature and
fires it at the foe.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

413.name: MOVE_BRAVE_BIRD
description:
The user tucks in
its wings and charges
from a low altitude.
The user also takes
serious damage.

414.name: MOVE_EARTH_POWER
description:
The user makes the
ground under the foe
erupt with power.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

415.name: MOVE_SWITCHEROO
description:
The user trades held
items with the foe
faster than the eye
can follow.

416.name: MOVE_GIGA_IMPACT
description:
The user charges at
the foe using every
bit of its power.
The user must rest
on the next turn.

417.name: MOVE_NASTY_PLOT
description:
The user stimulates
its brain by thinking
bad thoughts.
It sharply raises the
user’s Sp. Atk.

418.name: MOVE_BULLET_PUNCH
description:
The user strikes
with a tough punch as
fast as a bullet.
This move always goes
first.

419.name: MOVE_AVALANCHE
description:
An attack move that
inflicts double the
damage if the user
has been hurt by the
foe in the same turn.

420.name: MOVE_ICE_SHARD
description:
The user flash
freezes chunks of
ice and hurls them.
This move always goes
first.

421.name: MOVE_SHADOW_CLAW
description:
The user slashes with
a sharp claw made
from shadows.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

422.name: MOVE_THUNDER_FANG
description:
The user bites with
electrified fangs.
It may also make the
foe flinch or become
paralyzed.

423.name: MOVE_ICE_FANG
description:
The user bites with
cold-infused fangs.
It may also make the
foe flinch or freeze.

424.name: MOVE_FIRE_FANG
description:
The user bites with
flame-cloaked fangs.
It may also make the
foe flinch or sustain
a burn.

425.name: MOVE_SHADOW_SNEAK
description:
The user extends its
shadow and attacks
the foe from behind.
This move always goes
first.

426.name: MOVE_MUD_BOMB
description:
The user launches a
hard-packed mud ball
to attack.
It may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

427.name: MOVE_PSYCHO_CUT
description:
The user tears at
the foe with blades
formed by psychic
power. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

428.name: MOVE_ZEN_HEADBUTT
description:
The user focuses its
willpower to its head
and rams the foe.
It may also make the
target flinch.

429.name: MOVE_MIRROR_SHOT
description:
The user looses a
flash of energy from
its polished body.
It may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

430.name: MOVE_FLASH_CANNON
description:
The user gathers all
its light energy and
releases it at once.
It may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def stat.

431.name: MOVE_ROCK_CLIMB
description:
A charging attack
that may also leave
the foe confused.
It can also be used
to scale rocky walls.

432.name: MOVE_DEFOG
description:
Obstacles are moved,
reducing the foe’s
evasion stat. It can
also be used to
clear deep fog, etc.

433.name: MOVE_TRICK_ROOM
description:
The user creates a
bizarre area in which
slower Pokémon get
to move first for five
turns.

434.name: MOVE_DRACO_METEOR
description:
Comets are summoned
down from the sky.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

435.name: MOVE_DISCHARGE
description:
A flare of electricity
is loosed to strike
all Pokémon in battle.
It may also cause
paralysis.

436.name: MOVE_LAVA_PLUME
description:
An inferno of scarlet
flames washes over
all Pokémon in battle.
It may also inflict
burns.

437.name: MOVE_LEAF_STORM
description:
A storm of sharp
leaves is whipped up.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

438.name: MOVE_POWER_WHIP
description:
The user violently
whirls its vines or
tentacles to harshly
lash the foe.

439.name: MOVE_ROCK_WRECKER
description:
The user launches a
huge boulder at the
foe to attack.
It must rest on the
next turn, however.

440.name: MOVE_CROSS_POISON
description:
A slashing attack
that may also leave
the target poisoned.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

441.name: MOVE_GUNK_SHOT
description:
The user shoots
filthy garbage at the
foe to attack.
It may also poison
the target.

442.name: MOVE_IRON_HEAD
description:
The foe slams the
target with its
steel-hard head.
It may also make the
target flinch.

443.name: MOVE_MAGNET_BOMB
description:
The user launches a
steel bomb that
sticks to the target.
This attack will not
miss.

444.name: MOVE_STONE_EDGE
description:
The user stabs the
foe with a sharpened
stone. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

445.name: MOVE_CAPTIVATE
description:
If it is the opposite
gender of the user,
the foe is charmed
into sharply lowering
its Sp. Atk stat.

446.name: MOVE_STEALTH_ROCK
description:
The user lays a trap
of levitating stones
around the foe. The
trap hurts foes that
switch into battle.

447.name: MOVE_GRASS_KNOT
description:
The user snares the
foe with grass and
trips it. The heavier
the foe, the greater
the damage.

448.name: MOVE_CHATTER
description:
The user attacks
using a sound wave
based on words it has
learned. It may also
confuse the foe.

449.name: MOVE_JUDGMENT
description:
The user releases
countless shots of
light. Its type varies
with the kind of Plate
the user is holding.

450.name: MOVE_BUG_BITE
description:
The user bites the
foe. If the foe is
holding a Berry, the
user eats it and
gains its effect.

451.name: MOVE_CHARGE_BEAM
description:
The user fires a
concentrated bundle
of electricity. It may
also raise the user’s
Sp. Atk stat.

452.name: MOVE_WOOD_HAMMER
description:
The user slams its
rugged body into the
foe to attack. The
user also sustains
serious damage.

453.name: MOVE_AQUA_JET
description:
The user lunges at
the foe at a speed
that makes it almost
invisible. It is sure
to strike first.

454.name: MOVE_ATTACK_ORDER
description:
The user calls out
its underlings to
pummel the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

455.name: MOVE_DEFEND_ORDER
description:
The user calls out
its underlings to
shield its body,
raising its Defense
and Sp. Def stats.

456.name: MOVE_HEAL_ORDER
description:
The user calls out
its underlings to heal
it. The user regains
up to half of its
max HP.

457.name: MOVE_HEAD_SMASH
description:
The user delivers a
life-endangering head
butt at full power.
The user also takes
terrible damage.

458.name: MOVE_DOUBLE_HIT
description:
The user slams the
foe with a tail, etc.
The target is hit
twice in a row.

459.name: MOVE_ROAR_OF_TIME
description:
The user blasts the
foe with power that
distorts even time.
The user must rest
on the next turn.

460.name: MOVE_SPACIAL_REND
description:
The user tears the
foe along with the
space around it.
This move has a high
critical-hit ratio.

461.name: MOVE_LUNAR_DANCE
description:
The user faints. In
return, the Pokémon
taking its place will
have its status and
HP fully restored.

462.name: MOVE_CRUSH_GRIP
description:
The foe is crushed
with great force.
The attack is more
powerful the more HP
the foe has left.

463.name: MOVE_MAGMA_STORM
description:
The foe becomes
trapped within a
maelstrom of fire
that rages for two
to five turns.

464.name: MOVE_DARK_VOID
description:
The foe is dragged
into a world of total
darkness that puts it
to sleep.

465.name: MOVE_SEED_FLARE
description:
The user generates
a shock wave from
within its body.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

466.name: MOVE_OMINOUS_WIND
description:
The user creates a
gust of repulsive
wind. It may also
raise all the user’s
stats at once.

467.name: MOVE_SHADOW_FORCE
description:
The user disappears,
then strikes the foe
on the second turn.
It hits even if the
foe used Protect.
